الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ثُوَيْرِ بْنِ أَبِي فَاخِتَةَ
الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ثُوَيْرِ بْنِ أَبِي فَاخِتَةَ

notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» names the compiler's father only as «أبي»: relation (rule 7); the first three names are co-transmitters joined by «وَ» and «جَمِيعاً»
Husayn ibn Thuwayr narrates in the first person; the Imam is the last link because the words after the chain are his, given in the place «عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» (ruling 2)
Yunus ibn Zabyan, al-Mufaddal and Abu Salama sit in the scene; Yunus speaks a question inside the report, so none of them is a transmitter and none is added
Blessings and «رَحِمَهُمُ اللَّهُ» are left out; RWY's route has no Imam, while the text writes him
